actions.text: Committee on Veterans' Affairs. Ordered to be reported with an amendment in the nature of a substitute favorably.
Committee on Veterans' Affairs. Hearings held. Hearings printed: S.Hrg. 119-247.
Read twice and referred to the Committee on Veterans' Affairs.

dimensions.assessment: Affects descendants of toxic-exposed veterans, members of the Interagency Working Group on Toxic Exposure, and the Agency for Toxic Substances and Disease Registry.
dimensions.evidence: research on the diagnosis and treatment of health conditions of descendants of toxic-exposed veteran

dimensions.assessment: Creates administrative research and reporting duties to study health conditions and make recommendations for legislative or administrative action.
dimensions.evidence: establish an interagency task force to conduct research on the diagnosis and treatment of health conditions

dimensions.assessment: The source material does not state specific dollar amounts for federal spending or revenue.

Amends existing law (the Sergeant First Class Heath Robinson Honoring our Promise to Address Comprehensive Toxics Act of 2022) to add specific interagency research and reporting requirements regarding veteran descendants.
dimensions.evidence: Subsection (b) of section 501 of the Sergeant First Class Heath Robinson Honoring our Promise to Address Comprehensive Toxics Act of 2022

dimensions.assessment: Requires an initial report within 180 days and 1 year, followed by annual summaries during a five-year period covered by a strategic plan.
dimensions.evidence: Not less frequently than annually during the five-year period covered by the strategic plan

missing_information: Specific cost estimates or authorized appropriations for carrying out the research and maintaining the website.
importance_detail.rationale: The bill mandates federal interagency task forces to conduct collaborative research on the diagnosis and treatment of health conditions in descendants of toxic-exposed veterans, maintain a public website, and submit reports to Congress.
